text: PAWL-034 AC2 claimed rendering outside a repository establishes that no git, network or model call was made. It does not: git --version succeeds anywhere, a discarded error leaves no trace, and no absent .git prevents a network call. Marked partially and closed in the same changeset by AC3's import-graph check plus the scenario, which between them narrow the residual failure to a runtime call through an interface the module already imports
